brief:
Doctors Without Borders said an Israeli airstrike directly hit one of its clinics in Gaza on Friday, killing two of its employees, Middle East Eye reported. The organization characterized the strike as a "direct hit," suggesting the facility was deliberately targeted.

The deaths mark another instance of medical infrastructure coming under fire during the conflict in Gaza. Doctors Without Borders operates several clinics across the territory providing emergency medical care to civilians.
dek: Doctors Without Borders says two staff killed in Israeli 'direct hit' on Gaza clinic Two employees of Doctors Without Borders (MSF) were killed in an Israeli strike on one of the organisation's clinics in the Gaza Strip on Friday.
title: Israeli strike kills two Doctors Without Borders staff in Gaza clinic
